That's exactly what I needed for getting started. It let me pick the file my browser exports, and before touching anything it showed me a clear summary — 247 bookmarks found, 12 folders that would become labels (with the folder names listed), and how many had their original saved dates. Nothing changed until I said go, which is reassuring. After I confirmed, the imported bookmarks came in keeping their names, carrying their old folders as labels, and holding onto their saved dates. That's precisely how I'd want to move my scattered browser collection in without losing what I had or redoing it by hand. Really pleased with this.

That's the import half sorted. Still open from last round is the flip side — being able to export my whole collection back out to a file for safekeeping. Could we do that one next? (And the save-a-search and comfort-settings bits are still waiting too, whenever you're ready.)
